method.effective_MAC: Conv: N*OC*channels_per_group*(sum valid h/kernel_h pairs)*(sum valid w/kernel_w pairs), skipping source coordinates outside the input exactly as generic spatial_run. MatMul: output element count * reduction K.
method.nominal_MAC: Conv: output element count * channels_per_group * kernel_h * kernel_w, including padded positions. MatMul: same as effective_MAC.
method.MAC_definition: One scalar multiplication contributing to a sum counts as one MAC; this is not an FMA instruction count. Frozen code uses ordered multiply then add.
method.non_MAC_rows: effective_MAC=0 means no counted Conv/MatMul MAC, not zero work or zero measured time.
method.padding: Out-of-range taps are skipped; no multiply-by-zero operations are invented.
method.steady_rate_projection: 12.5 graph evaluations/audio-second assumes the already established 1280-sample embedding hop at 16 kHz; runtime is not inferred.
method.storage: Constant sizes are from this manifest. The 197908-byte head size is the fixed SDK artifact size supplied for this analysis. No model or executable was run.
